title: A fix item's check never sees notes added after it
what: A fix item's check never sees notes added after it
why: Found 27 Oct by the queue-edit design: when a branch takes a fix item, its problem becomes finding Q1 from the item's text only; Q1 carries no notes, so a correction or a measurement added after `add` never reaches the check of that branch. 9 open fix items carry fact notes today. Live: the-wave-paid-run-of-9bc988d-is-red-in-3-eval-ca got a correcting fact note 36 minutes after it was taken.
failing_case: A fix item with a fact note, taken by a branch: relay check findings --item shows Q1 without the note's text.
pass_cases: Once taken, Q1's details include every note of the item, dated.
A note added after the take reaches Q1 once the branch takes the default branch.
A test in a temporary folder fails without it.
